quotes.text: The address book replacement uses empty-src icon images in search-bar buttons. During D211136 review, the author found about:addressbook lives in a content browser whose contentAreaClick handler treated any image click as an attachment image, so button clicks were intercepted. The landed patch guarded that old handler with target.src. That handler is absent from the current checkout, so this is a historical breakage lesson: when putting icon images inside buttons in a content browser, test actual clicks through the host click handler, not only widget events.
